skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Strikes a single target with a 3-hit combo, dealing 35% ATK(+3) damage.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks a single target in the back row 2 to 5 times, dealing up to 100% ATK(+2) damage.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks a single target in the back row 3 to 5 times, dealing up to 100% ATK(+2) damage.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP(+20). When attacking a Monster or Bounty Criminal, inflicts [Injured] on the target for 2 turns (adds Injured damage equal to 50% ATK when attacked).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP(+20). Attacks inflict [Injured] on the target for 2 turns (adds Injured damage equal to 70% ATK when attacked).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP(+20). Attacks inflict [Injured] on the target for 2 turns (adds Injured damage equal to 75% ATK when attacked).
